responsibility: This definition module exposes filename-manipulation helpers used by mc when mapping module names to source filenames and back. It provides routines to form module-plus-extension filenames, derive stem names, strip a known extension, and extract the final path component, isolating platform-dependent naming policy from the rest of the compiler driver and search logic.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the declaration-only interface for the mcFileName utilities, exporting the filename/stem/extraction procedures; the corresponding mcFileName.mod provides the actual path-separator and string-slicing logic behind those operations.
